title.value: Jalisco’s Multiclass Land Cover Analysis and Classification Using a Novel Lightweight ConvNet with Real-World Multispectral and Relief Data
title.justification: This title encompasses the main objective of the paper, which is applying a lightweight ConvNet for land cover analysis and classification in Jalisco using multispectral and relief data.
title.quote: The understanding of global climate change, agriculture resilience, and deforestation control rely on the timely observations of the Land Use and Land Cover Change (LULCC).

extractions.description: The paper presents a novel lightweight convolutional neural network (ConvNet) designed to classify and analyze land cover (LC) in the Jalisco region. It addresses challenges specific to regional data, including large class numbers, diverse climates, and imbalanced datasets, by utilizing 13 channels of real-world open data. The model demonstrated accuracy improvement in LC classification, which aids policy makers in land management, aligning with SDG 15 for 'Life on Land'.
